attempts.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (standbys) on CentOS Stream 10. Demonstrated failover: stopped node1, promoted node2 to writable primary with zero committed-data loss, verified new writes replicate, repointed node3 to follow node2, then rebuilt node1 via pg_basebackup as a standby of node2. Completed mandatory node-restart protocol: restarted node1, node3, then node2 (the then-current primary) one at a time via systemctl reboot, confirming changed /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id on each and full data/replication recovery before proceeding to the next node.
